name: The Causeway Breathes
effect: Place 1 Stone Route marker on an empty tile within 2 of the center tile. The active player's first movement action this turn may treat that marker as adjacent to one allied placed object or Leak marker.
role: The drowned ley-road wakes because something buried has begun calling through it.
mechanical_lane: Stone Route movement and temporary route placement.

narrative.summary: A submerged basalt causeway shifts for the first time in centuries. The survivors know this is not a miracle. It is a warning.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The roads were not built only for evacuation; some were built to hide what Atlantis did before the Flood.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Signature board marker names are provisional until Stone Route and Memory rules are finalized.

name: Black Water Remembers
effect: Choose up to 2 characters adjacent to placed objects. Each gains 1 Memory marker, max 1 per character. A character that gains Memory this way also becomes Marked until the end of the round.
role: Floodwater reflects the truth of what happened during the fall of Atlantis.

narrative.summary: A flooded tomb shaft turns black and reflective. Those who look into it do not see themselves. They see the moment the water came.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Some survivors were saved because other survivors were deliberately sealed out.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Leans into forbidden truth rather than pure protection.

name: The Vault Chooses A Witness
effect: Choose 1 allied character adjacent to a placed object. It gains +1 RANGE on AP abilities this turn and becomes Marked until the end of the round.
role: A sealed archive opens for one character and brands them with knowledge others were denied.
mechanical_lane: Single-character knowledge bonus with exposure cost.

narrative.summary: The vault door ignores priests, soldiers, and queens. It opens for one witness only.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The archive does not preserve the official version. It preserves the version someone died to hide.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Good visual tie to Iset-Nara and Sahu-Ren.

name: The Name Was Cut From Stone
effect: Choose 1 enemy within 2 tiles of a placed object. Remove Shield from it or Mark it until the end of the round.
role: A carved royal name has been chiseled out of a monument, but the missing name appears in wet light.
mechanical_lane: Expose protected characters without using the Black Sarcophagus as an event.

narrative.summary: A missing name returns as water-light in a wound carved through stone.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The post-flood royal line may have been founded on a deliberate erasure.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Replaces direct Black Sarcophagus event energy; Black Sarcophagus remains a relic.

name: Ley Stones Align
effect: Until end of turn, the active player's first AP ability may measure range from an allied placed object instead of from the acting character.
role: Ancient stones form a pattern that was not built for travel, but for hiding a crime.

narrative.summary: Basalt markers beneath the board align with stars no living sky still shows.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The geometry was designed to preserve a secret, not a civilization.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Avoids deck viewing/manipulation and strengthens Flood Survivor object identity.

name: The Drowned Seraph Speaks
effect: Until the start of the active player's next turn, the first enemy that damages an allied character with Memory becomes Marked.
role: The entity inside Thalassa-Nekh speaks a judgment no ruler can redact.

narrative.summary: The water speaks through a human mouth, and every listener remembers being guilty.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The thing named holy by the survivors may not belong to them, and may not forgive them.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Should feel spiritual and unsettling rather than generic angelic intervention.

name: Tide-Sealed Archive Opens
effect: Choose one: give 1 ally Shield, or give 1 ally Shield and +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn, then Mark that ally until the end of the round.
role: Meret-Anu's preserved records reveal a controlled truth, but the full archive wants release.
mechanical_lane: Choice between safe benefit and stronger exposed benefit.

narrative.summary: The sealed casket opens enough to help, but not enough to be honest.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Meret-Anu has protected her people by controlling which truths are allowed to survive.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Tide-Sealed Archive can also remain a relic; this event represents a temporary opening of that relic's records.

name: Exiles Walk Beneath Egypt
effect: Move up to 2 allied characters that are adjacent to placed objects up to 1 tile each. They must end on empty tiles.
role: The survivors carry forbidden Atlantean memory into underground routes, tomb geometry, and future mystery traditions.
mechanical_lane: Small group reposition around placed objects.

narrative.summary: The flood survivors do not return to the surface as conquerors. They travel beneath it, leaving measurements, rites, and secrets inside stone.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Egypt and later mystery traditions may have inherited not a pure wisdom, but a carefully edited survivor record.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Bridge card from Flood Survivors into Egyptian/Hermetic story material.
